html:
Let’s join Vietlook Travel to review the famous Cao Bang tourist attractions before having the opportunity to set foot here, to have the most perfect trip, please refer to it right away.

Cao Bang is a place with high, undulating rocky mountains, winding slopes, a beautiful natural landscape, so when coming to Cao Bang, visitors also visit mysterious caves, waterfalls or cool, clear streams that are places to escape the sun on summer days.

Cao Bang tourist attractions

Ban Gioc Waterfall

The waterfall is divided into 3 levels, looking down from above like a long white silk strip, stretching across the hillside, at the foot of the waterfall is a peaceful river, surrounded by grass, cool green forests, is the most beautiful place to escape the sun every summer.

Buddhist Pagoda Truc Lam Ban Gioc

The pagoda is located right on Phia Nham mountain, with a pure Vietnamese design, from the entrance, visitors can see a solemn, peaceful look from the pagoda, visitors can take in the whole beauty of Cao Bang.

Nguom Ngao Cave

This is one of the large caves in Cao Bang, a tourist attraction that many tourists visit when they have the opportunity to set foot in Cao Bang, where the weather is cool, surrounded by cliffs, inside are stalactites, visitors can take beautiful pictures when coming to Cao Bang.

Thang Hen Lake

As one of the large and clear lakes, if you have the opportunity to travel to Cao Bang, visitors should experience floating rafts to admire the peaceful scenery of the plateau.

Pac Bo Relic Site

Ku is a meaningful historical relic, when coming here, visitors will visit places such as: Coc Bo Cave, milestone 108, Cac Mac Mountain, Lenin Stream, Khuoi Nam hut, President Ho Chi Minh Memorial House and square yard, Kim Dong Relic Complex…

1950 Border Campaign Victory Relic Site

Although located about 45 km south of Cao Bang city center, this is a relic site associated with the Dong Khe Victory, the opening battle for the 1950 Border Campaign, including items such as the Cemetery and Memorial House, Dong Khe Fort relic, the relic located in the enemy’s defense system to protect Dong Khe stronghold…

Ma Phuc Pass

The winding and rugged pass is a destination for those who love to conquer, want to challenge themselves and admire the peaceful scenery from the top of the pass, then Ma Phuc Pass is the destination for you.

The pass is 3.5km long, and 700m above sea level, to reach the top of the pass you have to conquer 7 steep turns, surrounded by rows of rocks and rows of cool green trees.

Me Pia Pass

A destination for backpackers, especially in the fall, the road is surrounded by red leaf forests, as if you were in the West, not in Cao Bang.

To conquer the pass interestingly and admire the scenery, you should travel to Cao Bang in the last months of the year, at this time the weather is clear, there is no rain, and there are clouds or fragrant buckwheat flowers, it is the right time for visitors to check in.

Cao Bang Ancient Stone Village

Here you will visit the stilt houses of the Tay people, and experience the culture, customs and daily activities, surrounded by unique stone walls, in addition you can enjoy delicious food with the gentle and hospitable people.

So with the natural scenery and rich history and culture, when coming to Cao Bang, visitors not only admire the natural scenery, but also visit meaningful historical relic sites, especially experience the life everyday with ethnic minorities, with gentle and hospitable smiles.
